newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 21.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 22 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Viktor Mihkailov, Russia's Atomic Energy Minister, will sign a contract on selling uranium to a little-known U.S. company.
- Sergei Dubinin, head of Russia's Central Bank, is to report on Tursday on the government's monetary policy for 1997 at the seventh congress of the Association of Russian Banks.
- The government will discuss Russia's new draft Tax Code at the end of April.

- A group of leading journalists signed an appeal calling on President Boris Yeltsin to intervene in the fight between mass media and business groups which they say are trying to influence political reporting.
- Four patients died in one day in southern Russian hospital for lack of medicine.
